scope: 0.1.4 release candidate bounded evidence. Synthetic development screening only; no formal score improvement or platform qualification is claimed.

policy.retained: Small unchanged normalized final records and bounded lossy projections of larger local reports.
policy.notRetained: Full journals, observed XML-like node trees, tool transcripts, full scripts, credentials, session IDs and raw stdout/stderr.
policy.archiveClaim: No omitted local original is claimed as a release-archive member. Digests identify local originals only.
policy.privacy: Personal absolute paths, credentials, session IDs, transcripts and XML are not published. Historical temp paths inside unchanged records were left unchanged.

actualBaselineBytes.note: The copied baseline documents are the actual old-arm input bytes used by the paired screening.

textualSnapshotProvenance.note: Historical textual reconstructions. Their sha256 values differ from the retained baseline byte hashes. Both are preserved; manifest.oldAssets identifies actual baseline bytes. No original record was silently edited or reconciled.

baselineIdentity.resolution: Copies at baseline/SKILL.md and baseline/references/*.md are actual baseline inputs for the documented --baseline command. baseline-provenance.json remains a separate historical snapshot record and is not relabeled as byte provenance.

digestScope.baselineProvenanceSha256: manifest.baselineProvenanceSha256 matches the retained baseline-provenance.json bytes; this verifies the provenance record, not the baseline .md byte hashes.
digestScope.smokeHistoricalPaths: Review and native-query records name historical report paths that now hold bounded projections. Those names identify the same historical event, not current projection bytes; see retained[].retainedSha256.
